statusPausedDetail: Your bot is switched off. Turn it back on to rejoin chat.
statusDelegateDetail: You have view-only access. Only the account owner can change the connection.
issueAllDisabled: All your commands are switched off, so the bot stays silent.
setupConnect: Connect the bot to your channel
description: Manage your bot connection and commands from here.
issueReauth: Twitch revoked the bot’s access to your channel. This happens after a password change or if the app was disconnected on Twitch. Reconnect your Twitch account to bring the bot back.
issueBotBanned: Your Twitch chat banned the bot, so it can’t read or answer messages. Twitch access itself is fine. Unban the bot in your chat, then press Enable.
actionFailed: That didn't go through. Try again.
commandsUnavailableDesc: The service is unreachable right now.
subFixPre: The bot lost its chat connection. Fix it in
issueNoAuth: The bot has no Twitch authorization for your channel.
issueIdle: The bot is connected but not replying in chat.
issueSubs: The bot lost its chat connection, so viewers might not get replies.
issueNoCommands: You have no commands yet. The bot has nothing to say.
allGood: Everything's running. Nothing needs you right now.
addAnotherDesc: Create, edit, and tune cooldowns for your channel responses.
createFirstCommandDesc: Custom responses your viewers trigger with !name in chat.
checkAccessDesc: Reconnect Twitch or manage shared dashboard links.
modalRestartBody: This closes the bot's chat connection and opens it again right away.
modalDisconnectBody: This takes your bot out of chat and closes its connection.
streamLastRan: Last stream ran {d}. The bot stayed in chat the whole time.
streamNeverSeen: No stream seen yet. This fills in the first time you go live.
streamUnavailable: Stream details are unavailable right now.
chatVolumeLegend: Tan ticks mark a command the bot answered
chatVolumeUnavailable: Chat volume is not being measured yet.
chatVolumeChartLabel: Chat messages per minute across the stream
feedUnavailable: The activity log is unavailable right now.
answeredEmpty: No commands answered in the recent window.
answeredUnavailable: Answered counts are unavailable right now.
